# DELETE /api/v1/repos/{owner}/{repo}/issues/{index}/subscriptions/{user}

Unsubscribe a user from an issue

**Module:** [routers](../modules/routers.md) · **Auth:** token · **ID:** `ep-219`

## Request

| Param | Location | Type | Required |
|-------|----------|------|----------|
| owner | path | string | True |
| repo | path | string | True |
| index | path | integer | True |
| user | path | string | True |

## Response

**201** — empty

- **200** — already unsubscribed
- **403** — non-admin trying to unsubscribe another user
- **404** — issue or user not found
